verses.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
verses.english: Indeed We sent it down on the Night of Ordainment.
And what will show you what is the Night of Ordainment?

verses.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
verses.english: The Night of Ordainment is better than a thousand months.
verses.transliteration_html: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin
verses.transliteration_text: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
verses.english: In it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, with every command.
verses.transliteration_html: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin
verses.transliteration_text: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin

verses.english: It is peaceful until the rising of the dawn.
